name: Irreverence
overview: Scripture reveals that irreverence manifests in dishonoring God, His representatives, and authority figures, as seen in the command not to revile gods or rulers (Exodus 22:28) and to honor parents (Exodus 20:12). True reverence is rooted in fearing the LORD, which is the foundation of knowledge and wisdom, while fools reject His instruction (Proverbs 1:7). God’s provision and guidance, such as feeding Israel with manna and teaching His statutes, underscore the necessity of living by His word with humility and obedience (Deuteronomy 8:3; Psalms 119:33).
